rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's seventeen builder trees go (magnolias, corals, ficus and jacarandas along the back fences, a magnolia 3 m from a house front, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two swing sets, the potted plants, on the open lot corner and in a yard inside the iron fence.

the west back yard's swing set (2.8 m off): a ficus over the swings
